correctness.rationale: The proof checks all nonadaptive x including 0 and 1, all measurable binary encoders including independent randomization, both bit relabelings, and all threshold boundaries. Conditional Brownian regression gives g(x)=x(1-2x/3); chi-square-one rearrangement proves unique threshold form; strict normal-hazard and lower-tail exponential-tilt orders prove exactly one scalar optimum. Exact Var(Q)=1/3, posterior centroids, and risk constants are derived in RESULT.md. verify.py replays exact rational identities and high-precision Gaussian integrals as corroboration.

value.rationale: A naturally specified numerical path-functional estimation question has an exact and globally unique single-bit sensor and two-sided comparator, a physically meaningful bit-event rate and explicit Bayes risk. The zero-information sign-bit versus 55.033% magnitude-bit separation is substantive under a fixed one-bit budget; it is a precise benchmark for quantized nonlinear path sampling and is not a trivial generic Gaussian-mean variant. No broader Gaussian path theorem, multi-sensor result or published-level impact is asserted.
